mainEntity.name: How can I begin with black and white photography?

acceptedAnswer.text: To start with black and white photography, switch your camera to black and white mode and focus on capturing subjects that catch your interest. Aim for scenes with high contrast and pay attention to the histogram. Prioritise compositions that are highlighted by the interplay of light and shadow.

mainEntity.name: What are the fundamentals of black and white photography?

acceptedAnswer.text: Black and white photography eliminates the distraction of colours, placing greater emphasis on other elements such as the subject, shapes, textures, lighting, contrast, and overall composition. This shift can bring a new depth and intensity to your images.
